title: F-Q1: follower validates decode + envelope only, no Observer
description: Followers cannot bootstrap an Observer (GroupContext travels only inside encrypted Welcome/GroupInfo). They check decoding and envelope consistency only. Consequence: removed users at a domain that still has members keep receiving ciphertext; membership leave is explicit (Limitation). Correct mimi-mls lib.rs doc that says followers track an Observer. Approved by Mark 2026-10-18 (plan .7).
